<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Exam system overhaul:</strong> Following the NEET controversy, PM Modi has constituted a high-powered task force led by Nandan Nilekani to reform India&#x27;s examination system and introduce a paper leak amendment bill.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Legislative agenda:</strong> The Lok Sabha is scheduled to discuss a new bill concerning Supreme Court judges, while Telangana CM Revanth Reddy proposes lowering the minimum age for contesting elections to 21.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W11</a></span></li>
</ul>
